csv_scope_of_work: The City of Houston Housing and Community Development Department (HCD) seeks applications from developers of multifamily housing to finance the rehabilitation of existing multifamily properties or the acquisition of existing multifamily properties that will undergo rehabilitation. The purpose of this solicitation is to support the revitalization of affordable multifamily housing within the corporate boundaries of the City of Houston. Applicants must demonstrate the capacity to rehabilitate and operate multifamily housing that benefits low-to-moderate income individuals. Applications will be reviewed, underwritten, and scored based on a predetermined set of criteria outlined in the NOFA.

title: Developer for 2026 CDBG-DR24 Multifamily
short_description: Developer solicitation for rehabilitating affordable multifamily housing properties in Houston.
project_scope: Solicitation for developers of affordable multifamily housing within the corporate boundaries of the City of Houston. The program finances rehabilitation of existing multifamily properties or acquisition of existing multifamily properties followed by rehabilitation, targeting housing for low-to-moderate income individuals. No specific building sizes, unit counts, or gross floor areas are stated in the source.
services: Developer/design-build services with architecture, programming, civil engineering, and rehabilitation/refurbishment services for existing multifamily housing projects.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer solicitation for rehabilitation/refurbishment of existing multifamily housing.
- Existing building rehab is generally less relevant to sbp than new complex structures.
- No indication of long spans, special structural systems, bridges, roofs, towers, or sports facilities.
- Includes architecture and civil engineering, but the notice is not focused on structural design excellence.
- Affordable housing rehabilitation is typically outside sbp's core priority sectors.
construction_cost_explanation: Taken from the tender documents: Total Construction Cost stated as $52.0M.
fee_explanation: No explicit planning or engineering fee is stated in the source. The notice is a developer funding solicitation rather than a defined design fee procurement.
references_qualifications: Applicants must demonstrate the capacity to rehabilitate and operate multifamily housing benefiting low-to-moderate income individuals. Applications will be reviewed, underwritten, and scored based on criteria outlined in the NOFA. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the source excerpt.
award_criteria: Applications will be reviewed, underwritten, and scored based on a predetermined set of criteria outlined in the NOFA. Exact award criteria and weightings are not provided in the source excerpt.
